notes.title: "Princess Maker Go!Go! Princess" Patch Notes - 12/26/2019
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a freeze issue when a player drops the game on multiplay
[*]Fixed a pop-up issue when you try to re-join after you abandon the game on multiplay
[*]The game works properly when leaved player join the game again on multiplay
[/list]
We will do our best about fixing bugs and reacting feedback to make you play comfortable "Princess Maker Go!Go! Princess". 
Thank you
